The main uncertainty is the strong reported T2-FLAIR mismatch, which supports IDH-mutant astrocytoma/non-codeleted biology, but the older age, marked enhancement, necrosis, edema, and satellite disease favor IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and grade 4 behavior.
